title: When a measure becomes a target

probes.question: When a measure becomes a ____, it ceases to be a good measure.
Goodhart's core idea first appeared in an article about what?
options: Monetary policy in the United Kingdom

image.alt: Two foam archery targets with colourful rings on a green lawn while a child draws a bow.
image.credit: U.S. Army photo by Bryan Gatchell / Wikimedia Commons

body.question: A car dealership rewards its salespeople by the number of cars they sell each month. What are they likely to do?
options: Sell the same number as before
Sell more cars, even at a loss
body.reveal: Sell more cars, even at a loss. This is Goodhart's law: "When a measure becomes a target, it ceases to be a good measure." It is named after the British economist Charles Goodhart, who expressed the core idea in a 1975 article on monetary policy in the United Kingdom.
